prompt: Fix reserve(stock, lines) for order checkout. stock maps SKU strings to nonnegative integer stock; lines is a list of (SKU, quantity) pairs. Return a NEW stock dict after reserving the entire order. Duplicate SKUs must be aggregated. Empty lines returns an equal independent dict. Each quantity must be a positive integer (bool is not an integer here); invalid quantities raise ValueError. Unknown SKU raises KeyError; aggregated demand exceeding stock raises ValueError. Never mutate stock or lines, including when a later line fails. Validation must reject every invalid quantity even when another line already exceeds stock; which error occurs first otherwise is unspecified. Modify only inventory.py and optional tests/*.py. Preserve the public API. No dependency installation or commits.
